father_reveal.speaker: Biologik ota
father_reveal.text: Dara. Sen mening qizimsan. Men seni tizimdan yashirdim, lekin oxir-oqibat o‘zim ham uning mahbusiga aylandim.

father_answer.speaker: Dara
father_answer.text: Tartib deb millionlab odamlarning irodasini tortib olding. Buni qanday oqlaysan?

father_rejected.speaker: Biologik ota
father_rejected.text: Unda meni dushman deb bil. Lekin yadro qulaganda kim javob berishini o‘yla.

father_heard.speaker: Biologik ota
father_heard.text: Men seni himoya qilish uchun yaratgan protokolni endi sen tugatishing kerak.
